articles.title: New findings may shed light on burial sites of Japan's wartime chemical weapons
Syria outlines efforts to tackle Assad chemical weapons legacy at OPCW meeting in The Hague
articles.description: At the OPCW meeting in The Hague, a Syrian delegation highlighted efforts to address the legacy of the previous regime's chemical weapons, seeking international support for mine clearance and post-conflict recovery. Led by Minister Raed Al-Saleh, the delegation engaged in discussions to enhance cooperation on victim support, infrastructure rehabilitation, and the safe return of displaced Syrians, while emphasizing the need for a roadmap to complete the destruction of chemical weapons.

articles.title: No Seat in The Hague: The Chemical Weapons Question Haunts Sudan
